content: The Prototipo RS Red/Black/Orange shoes offer all-day comfort and versatility. They feature additional padding on the tongue, heel, and collar, an ONSTEAM anti-microbial lining for moisture and odor control, and a removable, contoured cork & EVA foam insole with a perforated footbed for extra comfort.
